name: Drifter
description: Wanderers, barbarians, and scavengers who live on the fringes of society.

assignments.name: Barbarian
assignments.description: You live on a primitive world without advanced technology.

assignments.name: Wanderer
assignments.description: You are a hitchhiker, hobo, or traveller who wanders from place to place.

assignments.name: Scavenger
assignments.description: You make a living by picking through the remains of civilisation.

events.description: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Mishap table but remain in career.

effects.detail: Roll on Mishap table, stay in career

events.description: A patron offers you a chance at a job.
events.effectDescription: If you accept, gain DM+4 to your next qualification roll but gain a Rival. If you refuse, gain an Ally.

effects.detail: Accept: DM+4 qualification + Rival. Refuse: Ally.

events.description: You pick up a few useful skills here and there.
events.effectDescription: Gain one of Jack-of-all-Trades 1, Survival 1, Streetwise 1 or Melee 1.

effects.detail: Gain JoaT 1, Survival 1, Streetwise 1 or Melee 1

events.description: You manage to scavenge something of use.
events.effectDescription: Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.
Roll Survival 8+ or Recon 8+. Succeed: gain a Contact and an extra Benefit roll. Fail: roll on the Injury table.

effects.detail: Survival/Recon 8+ for Contact + Benefit or Injury

events.description: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.effectDescription: Roll on the Life Events table.
Roll Melee 8+ or Gun Combat 8+. If you succeed, gain one level in a combat skill. If you fail, roll on the Injury table.

effects.detail: Melee/Gun Combat 8+ for combat skill or Injury

events.description: You are offered a chance to take part in a risky but potentially rewarding venture.
events.effectDescription: If you accept, roll Deception 8+ or Persuade 8+. Succeed: gain an extra Benefit roll. Fail: roll on the Mishap table.

events.description: Life on the edge hones your abilities.

events.effectDescription: Roll for the Draft next term.

mishaps.effectDescription: Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.

effects.detail: Roll twice on Injury table, take lower result

mishaps.description: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
You run afoul of a criminal gang, corrupt bureaucrat or other criminal. Gain an Enemy.
You suffer from a life-threatening illness.
mishaps.effectDescription: Lose 1 from END, STR or DEX.

effects.detail: Lose 1 from END, STR or DEX

mishaps.description: Betrayed by a friend. One of your Contacts or Allies betrays you, ending your career. That Contact or Ally becomes a Rival or Enemy.
mishaps.effectDescription: A Contact or Ally becomes a Rival or Enemy.

mishaps.description: You do not know what happened to you. There is a gap in your memory.

effects.detail: Gap in memory, no additional effect
